release.notes: M6.3E first reviewed content release: 10 full B2 Writing tests across 10 topic groups.

topics.title_vi: Thể thao và cơ sở vật chất

tests.title: Community Technology Club
tests.source_note: Original ForLanguage practice content; not copied from an official examination.

tasks.prompt: You have joined the community technology club. Answer five profile questions using short phrases.
questions: What is your name?
What technology do you use most?
How often do you visit the club?
What skill would you like to learn?
Who do you usually study with?
tasks.review_note: Reviewed for structure, topic coherence, B2 suitability, originality and register.

tasks.prompt: A club member asks why you joined. Write a reply.
tasks.review_note: Reviewed for structure, topic coherence, B2 suitability, originality and register.

tasks.prompt: Reply to the three members.
questions: Which workshop should the club organise next?
Should beginners and advanced members study together?
How can the club attract more members?
tasks.review_note: Reviewed for structure, topic coherence, B2 suitability, originality and register.

tasks.prompt: Write an email to a friend about a change to the club schedule and explain what you plan to do.
tasks.review_note: Reviewed for structure, topic coherence, B2 suitability, originality and register.

tasks.prompt: Write to the club secretary. Explain why the schedule change is inconvenient and suggest a solution.
tasks.review_note: Reviewed for structure, topic coherence, B2 suitability, originality and register.
